question: Assume today is 2026-09-12. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the number of passengers at London Heathrow Airport in September 2026, as reported in Heathrow's monthly traffic statistics.

target.what: Total passengers passing through London Heathrow Airport (LHR) during the calendar month of September 2026, as reported in Heathrow's monthly traffic statistics (all terminals, arrivals plus departures, domestic and international combined)
target.publisher: Heathrow Airport Limited (monthly traffic statistics / operational figures)
target.caveats: Period is future relative to the 2026-09-12 cutoff, so the month is incomplete and unreported; the estimate is a forecast. Heathrow reports 'passengers' as terminal throughput (enplaned + deplaned, domestic and international combined); some sources report only international or only one direction, wh

candidates.hypothesis: September 2026 passengers ≈ September 2025 passengers × (recent YoY growth trend) × (calendar/seasonal adjustment for September). September is a strong shoulder-season month; prior-year September levels and the 2026 monthly YoY growth rates (Jan–Aug 2026 vs 2025) anchor the level and trend.
candidates.data_to_find: Heathrow monthly passenger totals for September 2023, 2024, 2025 and all available 2026 months (Jan–Aug 2026) with YoY % changes; also monthly totals for July/August 2026 to capture summer peak and any capacity cap effects. Minimum: Sept 2025 total plus 2026 YTD YoY growth.

candidates.perspective: Airport slot/ATM and seat capacity planner
candidates.hypothesis: Passengers = air transport movements (ATMs) × average seats per movement × load factor × 2 (arrivals+departures counted once each). Heathrow operates near its ~480,000 ATM annual cap (~40,000/month); September ATMs × seats × load factor gives a capacity-based estimate.
candidates.data_to_find: Heathrow monthly ATMs for September 2025 and 2026 YTD; average seats per ATM and load factor at Heathrow (or UK/European widebody+narrowbody mix); the annual ATM cap and any 2026 changes. Substitute: CAA airport statistics for Heathrow movements and terminal passengers.

candidates.hypothesis: CAA publishes Heathrow terminal passenger totals monthly; September 2026 CAA figure should match Heathrow's own statistic. CAA 2025 September value and 2026 monthly pattern provide an independent cross-check and a bridge if Heathrow's own release is unavailable.
candidates.data_to_find: CAA airport data for Heathrow: monthly terminal passengers and movements for 2025 and 2026 (through latest available month before cutoff); September 2025 value specifically. Minimum: Sept 2025 CAA total and 2026 YTD YoY.
search_hints: CAA airport statistics Heathrow terminal passengers monthly
UK airport passenger numbers September 2025 Heathrow

candidates.hypothesis: Heathrow passengers ≈ sum over airlines of (seats offered × load factor). Major carriers (BA, Virgin, and foreign flag carriers) publish or are tracked for Heathrow seat capacity; aggregating scheduled seats for September 2026 and applying a load factor yields the total.
candidates.data_to_find: Scheduled seat capacity at LHR for September 2026 by airline (OAG/Cirium-type data or airline schedules); Heathrow load factor (typically ~80–85%). Minimum: total scheduled departing seats at LHR in Sept 2026 and an assumed load factor.

candidates.hypothesis: September 2026 passengers could deviate from trend due to strikes, ATC disruptions, weather, capacity caps, or new routes/airline failures. Identifying known scheduled disruptions or capacity changes before the cutoff adjusts the trend-based estimate up or down.
candidates.data_to_find: Announced strikes, ATC issues, Heathrow capacity/terminal changes, airline route launches or exits affecting LHR for September 2026; any Heathrow passenger guidance for 2026. Minimum: confirmation of no major disruption or a quantified impact.

candidates.hypothesis: Heathrow, IATA, ACI Europe, or Oxford Economics publish 2026 passenger forecasts or Heathrow guidance; a full-year 2026 forecast can be decomposed into months using 2025 monthly shares to isolate September.
candidates.data_to_find: Heathrow 2026 full-year passenger guidance/forecast; ACI Europe or IATA UK/Europe 2026 traffic growth forecasts; 2025 monthly share of annual passengers falling in September. Minimum: a 2026 annual total or growth rate plus September seasonal share.

candidates.hypothesis: September's share of annual Heathrow passengers is stable (~8.0–8.5%); annual 2026 passengers × September share gives the monthly figure. This route needs the annual level and the seasonal share rather than monthly history.
candidates.data_to_find: Heathrow annual passenger totals 2023–2025 and monthly distribution to compute September share; 2026 annual estimate. Minimum: September share from 2024/2025 and a 2026 annual level.

methods.label: m1

methods.rationale: Anchors on the exact September 2025 table total and applies a trend-based YoY factor reflecting the 2026 deterioration from -0.4% (Jan–Aug) to -2.1% (August). Shared dependency: both m1 and m2 rely on the same Heathrow release family; failure mode is an unanticipated September shock.

methods.label: m2
methods.rationale: Seasonal-share route: full-year 2025 total times a flat 2026 level factor times September's stable share. Independent of the September 2025 base level, though it shares the Heathrow release source. Failure mode: September share shifts materially.

methods.label: m3

a1.role: September 2026 YoY change factor vs September 2025

methods.rationale: Capacity-based cross-check: September 2025 ATMs times the August 2026 passengers-per-ATM ratio (p171/p184) times the YoY factor. Uses the observed 2026 load/capacity relationship rather than an assumed load factor. Failure mode: September load factor differs from August's peak-summer ratio.

kept.rationale: Jan–Aug 2026 was -0.4% YoY (p178) but August deteriorated to -2.1% (p177), driven by Middle East weakness (p183). September 2025 was a record base (p1). A modest decline slightly worse than the 8-month average but not as steep as August is the central case; range spans flat-to-soft recovery and cont
kept.applies_when: September 2026 traffic follows the recent 2026 trend rather than a new shock.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence of a sharp capacity cut, strike, or ATC closure in September 2026, or a rebound in Middle East traffic.

kept.name: September share of annual passengers
kept.rationale: September 2025 (7.348m, p1) was ~8.7% of full-year 2025 (84.463m, p146); September is a stable shoulder-season month, so the same share applied to a 2026 annual level is a reasonable seasonal decomposition.

Best estimate for total passengers at London Heathrow Airport (all terminals, arrivals plus departures, domestic and international) during September 2026: 7,370,982 person (80% model-based interval 4,369,056 to 12,435,493 person). This is a forecast; the month is future relative to the cutoff and unreported.

Evidence: September 2025 throughput was 7,348,000 passengers; full-year 2025 was 84,463,000 passengers; September 2025 movements were 40,193 air transport movements. August 2026 gave 7,867,000 passengers passengers on 41,048 air transport movements.
